title: Journey Home:
title_short: Day 3 PM · What can you offer
headline: The problem can feel too big. Dwayne asks one small thing: tell me what you can offer.
story: A voice-only volunteer call. Dwayne admits homelessness can feel overwhelming, then makes it small: tell him your skills, your experience, your passions, your time.
Journey Home needs people who can build with us. Friendly, light, and easy to say yes to.
